results.note: Official cathedral page lists the 'Individual' tourist visit at 16 € per person, VAT exempt. Entry is free during worship hours (not the standard ticket).

The official site (erotica-museum.com) shows a 'General Ticket' category but no amount, and its booking page redirects there. Third-party sources give roughly €13.50 to €15, but they disagree and aren't official, so I haven't reported a price.

No page states a standalone admission price for the chapel. It is part of the MUHBA Plaça del Rei site. The MUHBA page gives a €7.30 combined ticket, but it doesn't list the chapel among the included spaces, so I can't confirm that price covers it. Only a past open-day event (5 Feb 2025) was stated as free.

The official Moco ticket pages returned 403 errors, so I couldn't read a price on the page. Search summaries conflicted: they gave from €14.95 on one page and €16.95 on another, and a separate Dutch-page snippet gave €26.95. Prices also vary by time slot, so I haven't reported one.
